title: Cluster
description: A group of nearby changes drawn as one numbered cloud mark (docs/contracts/r1.md §3 `cluster`, sidecar `clusters[]` in docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §7). The cluster number is the number in the triangle badge and the row number in the revision table, so it is 1-based and gapless within a pair. `decision`, `user_label` and `note` are the user's edits from screen C; a re-run carries them over to the cluster with the same `signature`, which is what makes 승인·무시 survive re-comparison. Also the body of `PATCH /compare/pairs/{pair_id}/clusters/{number}`.

number.description: Cloud-mark number, 1-based, ordered top-left to bottom-right inside the frame. `id` is `"c" + number`.

signature.description: Hash of the sorted `(kind, before_handle, after_handle)` tuples of the cluster's changes (docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §7). Stored on the `cluster` row and used to carry `decision`/`user_label`/`note` across a re-run; the sidecar may omit it.

bbox.description: Union of the member changes' boxes, before the cloud margin is added, in the after sheet's world coordinates (mm). The review list zooms to this box plus the margin.

label.description: Automatic Korean label, `{종류} {행위}[ {수치}]` (`compare/labels.py`). Shown when `user_label` is null and written into the revision table's 내용 column.

user_label.description: Label the user typed on screen C. Wins over `label` everywhere. Null while untouched.

note.description: Free memo the user attached. Not printed on the drawing; it travels in `changes.tsv`.

change_ids.description: Member changes, `ch<seq>`, ascending. The `cluster` row stores the same set as `change_seqs` integers; the sidecar writes the ids.

cluster_id.title: ClusterId
cluster_id.description: `c<number>` -- deterministic within one pair, so the sidecar never carries a database ULID.

decision.title: ClusterDecision
decision.description: `pending` not reviewed yet, `approved` the cloud mark and a revision-table row are exported, `ignored` the cluster is dropped from the output (docs/contracts/r1.md §3).

cluster_kind.title: ClusterKind
cluster_kind.description: Dominant `Change.kind` of the members, or `mixed` when no single kind accounts for the cluster. Drives the icon in the review list only -- the cloud mark looks the same for every kind.

cloud.title: CloudMark
cloud.description: The revision cloud drawn on layer `REV-<YYYYMMDD>`: one closed LWPOLYLINE around `bbox` plus the margin, arcs bulging outwards (docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §5).

handle.description: Handle of the LWPOLYLINE inside the compare DXF. Null before the file is written.

points.description: Vertices `[x, y, bulge]`, counter-clockwise from the lower-left corner, closed. Coordinates are rounded to 3 decimals so the file is byte-stable across runs.

badge.title: ClusterBadge
badge.description: The numbered triangle anchored outside the cloud rectangle: an equilateral LWPOLYLINE plus the number as TEXT (docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §5).

shape_handle.description: Handle of the triangle inside the compare DXF. Null before the file is written.

text_handle.description: Handle of the number TEXT inside the compare DXF. Null before the file is written.

center.description: Centroid of the triangle `[x, y]` in millimetres -- the TEXT insertion point, and where the review list points the camera.
